subject: general
question: Who was conferred with the Tansen Samman 2020 by Madhya Pradesh government in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satish Vyas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satish Vyas** was conferred with the **Tansen Samman 2020 **by** the Madhya Pradesh government **in January 2021.
 
• Strict COVID-19 regulations were in place as the 96th Tansen Music Festival in Madhya Pradesh got underway in Gwalior.
 
• **Pandit Satish Vyas,** a renowned santoor player, received the prestigious Tansen Samman during the opening ceremony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Every year in the month of **December, the Gwalior district of Madhya Pradesh **celebrates **Tansen Samaroh**.
 
• This year's festival is the 97th. The musical spectacular lasts for 5 days.
 
• Here, musicians and artists from all over the world come to honour the legendary Indian musical maestro Tansen.
 
• The Academy of the Department of Culture, Government of Madhya Pradesh, is in charge of organising the event close to Tansen's tomb.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian classical vocalist C. R. Vyas' son, Satish Vyas, is a singer. With Shivkumar Sharma, he began studying the santoor in 1978.
 
• The modern representative of the Paluskar style of North Indian classical singing is the Hindustani vocalist **Pandit Vidyadhar Vyas**.
 
• An Indian classical sitar player is **Vidushi Manju Mehta**. 
 
• **Dalchand Sharma **is an eminent Pakhawaj exponent of “Nathdwara Gharana”.
